loading.heading: Loading verified data
loading.render: Neutral skeleton with aria-busy=true. No0 values or prior-account rows. Navigation and help remain available.

ready.heading: Data available
ready.render: Render complete scoped projection with origin,as-of,currency and allowed actions. Ready data does not imply trade authorization.

empty.heading: Screen-specific empty state
empty.render: Use exact screen empty_heading and next route. No charts with fake series. A domain-confirmed zero can be displayed as0 separately from an absent dataset.

denied.heading: Access unavailable
denied.render: 401 identity flow or403 action denial;404 for concealed cross-tenant objects. Do not include object count/title or existence leakage.

stale.heading: Last verified data is stale
stale.render: Retain same-scope last-good snapshot with timestamp and stale labels; disable new risk and stale-preview confirmation, retain allowed reconciliation/safety paths.

partial.heading: Some data is unavailable
partial.render: Panel-level status and missing fields. Do not sum incomplete items into a falsely complete total. Distinguish omitted basis from measured zero.

timeout.heading: The response was not received
timeout.render: GET can offer bounded retry; command timeout shows UNKNOWN plus operation ID and status read, never blind resubmit.

error.heading: This request could not complete
error.render: Sanitized reason and correlation ID; retain draft; bounded recovery action. No raw trace, secret URL or server-success toast.

unsupported.heading: This capability is not available for this scope
unsupported.render: Explain missing integration/rights/eligibility/data/profile. Configuration/read-only work remains usable. Blocked gate is not passing implementation evidence.

conflict.heading: This record changed
conflict.render: Show authorized old/new field diff; preserve local draft; require explicit reconciliation and fresh preview.

session_expired.heading: Your session has expired
session_expired.render: Mask personal data, stop polling, preserve only safe server draft. Reauthenticate and revalidate, never replay mutation automatically.

maintenance.heading: Service maintenance
maintenance.render: Separate UI pause from ongoing trade-management status. Show approved status and safe contact. No assumption that restart closed positions.
maintenance.effects: no new action through disabled interface
